name: io.github.anotb/open-market-data
title: Open Market Data
description: Read-only market, SEC, crypto, and macroeconomic data with provenance and free providers.

environmentVariables.name: FRED_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional free FRED API key for US economic time series and search.

environmentVariables.name: COINGECKO_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional CoinGecko demo API key for rankings and broader crypto coverage.

environmentVariables.name: FINNHUB_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional Finnhub API key for quote and earnings fallback.

environmentVariables.name: ALPHA_VANTAGE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional Alpha Vantage API key for quote, financial, and history fallback.

environmentVariables.name: EDGAR_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Descriptive SEC EDGAR user agent with an application name and contact email.
